messages.content: Hinglish mein samjhao ki AI model aur website mein kya difference hai.

AI model woh system hai jo text samajhne aur jawab generate karne ke liye trained hota hai. Website sirf user interface ho sakti hai jo model ko call karti hai. MJ AI ko apna model banane ke liye base model select karke apne examples par fine-tune karna hoga; sirf website design karne se model train nahi hota.
Python mein list ke duplicate values remove kaise karun, order bhi same rahe?

Python mein dict.fromkeys() use kar sakte ho; yeh insertion order preserve karta hai.
values = [3, 1, 3, 2, 1]
unique_values = list(dict.fromkeys(values))
print(unique_values)  # [3, 1, 2]
Agar items hashable nahi hain, to loop ke saath equality check karna padega.
Kya MJ AI ko bina GPU ke train kar sakta hoon?

Chhote experiments CPU par possible ho sakte hain, lekin useful language model fine-tuning CPU par bahut slow aur memory-heavy ho sakti hai. Pehle 0.5B jaise chhote open-weight base model par LoRA fine-tuning try karo. Compatible cloud GPU notebook madad kar sakta hai, lekin free availability aur session limits guaranteed nahi hote. Phone ya static website khud se large model train nahi kar sakti.
Mujhe 30 second ke Hindi YouTube Short ka script do: baarish ke baad shehar ki sadak.

TITLE: Baarish Ke Baad Shehar
HOOK (0–3 sec): Baarish ruk gayi… lekin shehar ki kahani ab shuru hoti hai.
SCENE 1 (3–8 sec): Paani mein streetlights ka reflection; slow tracking shot.
SCENE 2 (8–18 sec): Chai stall se uthti bhaap, log chalte hue, bus ke tyres se chhinta.
SCENE 3 (18–26 sec): Ek akela insaan puddle ke paas rukta hai.
OUTRO (26–30 sec): Wet road and fading headlights. Ask viewers what they love after rain.
Meri website par API key frontend mein daal du?

Nahi. API key ko HTML/JavaScript frontend mein kabhi mat rakho, kyunki visitor source code se use copy kar sakta hai. Key ko backend ke environment variables mein rakho, backend se provider call karo, aur rate limits/authentication lagao. Agar key pehle public ho chuki hai, use rotate karo.
